articles.title: Indonesia Hit by Android Banking App-Cloning Campaign
articles.threat_category: Ransomware | Data Breach | 0-Day & Exploit | Nation-State/APT | Cloud & Supply Chain | Vulnerability / Advisory
articles.executive_summary: The GoldFactory threat group is exploiting the Android Work Profile feature to deliver the Gigabud Trojan, targeting Indonesian users. This campaign poses a significant risk to financial institutions and individuals, as the Gigabud Trojan can steal sensitive information.
articles.technical_breakdown: The GoldFactory threat group is utilizing the Android Work Profile feature to bypass security measures and deliver the Gigabud Trojan. The Gigabud Trojan is designed to steal sensitive information, including login credentials and financial data.
actionable_mitigations: Ensure Android devices are running the latest version of the operating system and all apps are updated.
Disable the Android Work Profile feature if not required.
Implement a mobile threat defense solution to detect and block suspicious activity.
articles.telegram_snippet: GoldFactory threat group targets Indonesian users with Android banking app-cloning campaign, delivering Gigabud Trojan to steal sensitive information.

articles.title: New Android malware encrypts files, steals data, and harasses victims
articles.executive_summary: A new Android malware strain, Mantax Otax, combines ransomware and spyware capabilities to encrypt files, steal sensitive data, and harass victims. This malware poses a significant threat to Android users, emphasizing the need for enhanced security measures.
articles.technical_breakdown: Mantax Otax exploits Android vulnerabilities to gain unauthorized access, encrypt files, and steal sensitive data. The malware's ability to spam and harass victims adds an additional layer of complexity to its attack vector.
actionable_mitigations: Ensure Android devices are running the latest security patches
Use reputable antivirus software and enable real-time scanning
Be cautious when installing apps from unknown sources
articles.telegram_snippet: New Android malware, Mantax Otax, combines ransomware and spyware capabilities, encrypting files, stealing data, and harassing victims. Android users are advised to update their devices and use reputable antivirus software to mitigate this threat.

articles.title: Voice Callers Exploit BYOD to Reach Microsoft 365, Corporate Data
articles.executive_summary: Threat actors are exploiting Microsoft's Graph API to identify and target lucrative Microsoft 365 users, then passing their access to extortion groups for financial gain. This attack vector poses a significant operational risk to corporate data security.
articles.technical_breakdown: Threat actors use voice calls to trick users into divulging sensitive information, which is then used to authenticate with Microsoft's Graph API. This allows them to access corporate data and pass it to extortion groups.
actionable_mitigations: Implement multi-factor authentication for all Microsoft 365 users
Use network segmentation to isolate sensitive data
Monitor for suspicious login activity and implement detection and log monitoring indicators
articles.telegram_snippet: Threat actors exploit Microsoft's Graph API to target Microsoft 365 users, passing access to extortion groups for financial gain. Corporate data security at risk due to this attack vector.

articles.title: September Windows Server updates break Remote Desktop Services
articles.executive_summary: The September 2026 security updates are causing Remote Desktop Services failures on Windows Server 2019, 2022, and 2025 servers, preventing users from connecting. This issue requires a hard reset to restore functionality in some cases.
articles.technical_breakdown: The September 2026 security updates are causing Remote Desktop Services failures due to an unknown bug, which is affecting Windows Server 2019, 2022, and 2025 servers. The root cause is under investigation by Microsoft.
actionable_mitigations: Apply the latest patches from Microsoft to resolve the issue
Disable Remote Desktop Services temporarily until the issue is resolved
Monitor system logs for errors related to Remote Desktop Services
articles.telegram_snippet: September Windows Server updates are causing Remote Desktop Services failures on Windows Server 2019, 2022, and 2025 servers, requiring a hard reset in some cases.

articles.title: ThreatsDay: 200 Android Flaws, Browser-Built Phishing, 119K Scam Shops + 23 More Stories
articles.executive_summary: This week's security news highlights various vulnerabilities and flaws in Android and browser systems, allowing for phishing and scam activities. These issues often stem from exposed systems, old bugs, and untrusted services.
articles.technical_breakdown: The exploitation of these vulnerabilities often involves an extension asking for excessive access, trusted services being part of phishing chains, and exposed systems remaining unpatched. These flaws can be exploited by attackers to gain unauthorized access and conduct malicious activities.
actionable_mitigations: Ensure timely patching and software updates for Android and browser systems
Implement strict access controls and monitoring for extensions and services
Regularly scan and monitor systems for exposed vulnerabilities
articles.telegram_snippet: Multiple security vulnerabilities and flaws in Android and browser systems have been exposed, allowing for phishing and scam activities. Ensure timely patching and software updates to mitigate these risks.

articles.title: Conti ransomware gang member sentenced to 4 years in prison
articles.executive_summary: A Conti ransomware gang member was sentenced to 4 years in prison for his role in ransomware attacks between 2021 and 2022. This conviction highlights the ongoing efforts to disrupt and prosecute ransomware groups.
articles.technical_breakdown: The individual was involved in Conti ransomware attacks, which typically involve exploiting vulnerabilities or using social engineering tactics to gain access to victim systems. The attackers then encrypt files and demand ransom payments in exchange for the decryption key.
actionable_mitigations: Ensure software and systems are up-to-date with the latest security patches
Implement robust backup and disaster recovery procedures
Monitor network activity for suspicious behavior
articles.telegram_snippet: Conti ransomware gang member sentenced to 4 years in prison for 2021-2022 attacks.

articles.title: Surfshark VPN Exposes Internal Test Server to Hackers
articles.executive_summary: Hackers accessed Surfshark's internal test server due to a configuration error, exposing sensitive data. The breach highlights the importance of secure server configurations and regular security audits.
articles.technical_breakdown: A configuration error exposed Surfshark's internal test server to the internet, allowing hackers to access it. The breach was likely facilitated by a lack of proper security measures and monitoring.
actionable_mitigations: Regularly review and update server configurations to prevent exposure to the internet
Implement robust security measures, such as firewalls and intrusion detection systems
Conduct regular security audits and penetration testing to identify vulnerabilities
articles.telegram_snippet: Surfshark VPN exposed internal test server to hackers due to configuration error, highlighting importance of secure server configs and regular security audits.

articles.title: Microsoft Excel KB5002914 update causes copy and paste issues
articles.executive_summary: The KB5002914 Office security update is causing issues with copy and paste operations and formula dragging in Microsoft Excel. Removing or rolling back the update restores normal functionality.
articles.technical_breakdown: The update is causing a compatibility issue with Microsoft Excel, resulting in the inability to perform copy and paste operations and formula dragging. The root cause is a bug in the update that affects the Excel application.
actionable_mitigations: Remove or roll back the KB5002914 update
Apply a patch or software update to resolve the issue
Disable or remove any recently installed Office add-ins
articles.telegram_snippet: Microsoft Excel users report issues with copy and paste after installing KB5002914 update. Removing the update restores normal functionality.
